text: Illustrate the story here: Let's Golf Ross and his mom went to the mall. Ross got golf clubs and golf balls. The golf balls are small. The man from the mall said Ross can hit the balls in the hall. Ross taps the ball with the club. The ball rolls up the hall and hits the tall wall. "Look at me!" Ross calls to Mom from the hall. He did not want to stop but Mom said he had to go. It was fun to hit golf balls in the mall!
